warning_texts: The claims machine gate recomputes CLM-NET-CZ with check_plan order_date between 2025-01-01 and 2025-03-30 and never reads the claim period field, so its PASS does not certify that field.
audit/check_plan.json has no deterministic rule that a claim period must equal the spec population window, so that field is only judged here.
analysis/answers/R03.json treats CLM-NET-CZ as a country component of headline net revenue, which is numerically true only on the spec window, not on the period the claim declares.
summary: CLM-NET-CZ publishes 13527.24, which is delivered CZ net on the spec window 2025-01-01..2025-03-30, but its period field is 2025-01-01..2025-02-28; independent raw recalc of that declared window is 9248.36.
